title: Runtime 1.19: Field Briefs, Deal Sell Sheets & Live Demo Playlists
creator: Miguel Ortega
description: Objective: produce a compact, sales-ready enablement bundle aligned to runtime-1.19 GA that the field (AE/SE/CS) can use immediately in customer conversations. Deliverables: 1) Field Brief (1 page, single-slide summary) — technical highlights, clearly-stated customer benefits, recommended use cases; 2) Deal Sell Sheets (two variants: SMB and Enterprise) — one-pagers with TL;DR, pricing levers, competitive differentiation, and procurement triggers; 3) Live Demo Playlists — 3 scripted demo flows (Quick win, Deep integration, Resilience case) with step-by-step play, expected outputs, time-boxed checkpoints, and recording checklist; 4) Sales Q&A and Top 7 Objection Handlers; 5) One-pager release notes summary tailored for sales and CS; 6) Trainer checklist and 30-minute ramp slide deck for enablement sessions. Scope excludes deep legal pricing write-ups and customer-specific SOW language.
acceptance_criteria: - Field Brief PDF completed and approved by Product and Design; - SMB and Enterprise Sell Sheets reviewed and signed off by Sales Leadership and Revenue Ops; - 3 Demo Playlists recorded as 'golden runs' and uploaded to Drive with short timestamps; - Sales Q&A and objection handlers vetted with two AE pilots; - Release notes summary live in Sales Confluence page and linked from public release notes; - Trainer deck ready and scheduled for two live sessions before due_date; - All assets accessible in Drive + Redwood Enablement hub; - No outstanding technical blockers from Engineering that would materially change asset content.
